# Pagination API

Project a large result set into direct pages and boundary controls.

This page is lookup reference for the exact public contract. Start from the usage examples when you are composing or styling the component.

[Back to Pagination usage and examples](/components/pagination)

## Parts

Shared scope: <code class="component-scope-token">[data-scope="pagination"]</code>. Combine it with a part selector to keep styles local to this component.

## Keyboard interaction

| Key | Behavior |
| --- | --- |
| <kbd>Tab</kbd> | Move between pagination controls exposed as native buttons or links. |
| <kbd>Enter</kbd> / <kbd>Space</kbd> | Activate the focused page or boundary control. |
| <kbd>Home</kbd> / <kbd>End</kbd> | The terminal projection moves to the first or last page. |
